battle_dungeon_info103.en: Bandits set up their camp here. By robbing passersby, they've accumulated quite the wealth.
battle_dungeon_info103.pt: Bandidos montaram acampamento aqui. Ao roubar transeuntes, acumularam uma grande riqueza.
battle_dungeon_info103.ch: 此处有一个山贼营地，山贼通过搜刮附近过路人的财物，积累了不少好东西。

battle_dungeon_info1031.en: Don't let its quiet and peaceful atmosphere fool you. Ferocious monsters are lurking in the peach forest, awaiting their prey.
battle_dungeon_info1031.pt: Não se engane com sua atmosfera tranquila e pacífica. Monstros ferozes estão à espreita na floresta de pêssegos, aguardando suas presas.
battle_dungeon_info1031.ch: 此处是一块桃源之地，从地面上看并没有什么异常，但是一旦惊动了潜伏在桃林之中的怪物，可就不那么好脱身了。

battle_dungeon_info1032.en: Don't let its quiet and peaceful atmosphere fool you. Ferocious <r>Lizard Cavaliers</r> are lurking in the peach forest, awaiting their prey.
battle_dungeon_info1032.pt: Não se engane com sua atmosfera tranquila e pacífica. Ferozes <r>Cavaleiros Lagarto</r> estão à espreita na floresta de pêssegos, aguardando suas presas.
battle_dungeon_info1032.ch: 此处是一块桃源之地，栖息着大量的<r>蜥蜴侠客</r>，一旦惊动了潜伏在桃林之中的怪物，可就不那么好脱身了。

battle_dungeon_info1033.en: Don't let its quiet and peaceful atmosphere fool you. Ferocious <r>Lizard Fighters</r> are lurking there, awaiting their prey.
battle_dungeon_info1033.pt: Não se engane com sua atmosfera tranquila e pacífica. Ferozes <r>Lutadores Lagarto</r> estão à espreita ali, aguardando suas presas.
battle_dungeon_info1033.ch: 此处是一片神秘森林，栖息着大量的<r>蜥蜴力士</r>，一旦惊动了潜伏在森林之内的怪物，可就不那么好脱身了。

battle_dungeon_info104488.ch: 此处是一片神秘森林，栖息着大量的<r>蜥蜴枪兵</r>，一旦惊动了潜伏在森林之内的怪物，可就不那么好脱身了。

battle_dungeon_info105.en: Don't let its quiet and peaceful surface fool you. Ferocious monsters are lurking underneath this bog, awaiting their prey.
battle_dungeon_info105.pt: Não deixe que a superfície tranquila e pacífica engane você. Monstros ferozes espreitam sob este pântano, aguardando suas presas.
battle_dungeon_info105.ch: 此处是一块沼泽之地，从地面上看并没有什么异常，但是一旦惊动了潜伏在沼泽之下的怪物，可就不那么好脱身了。

battle_dungeon_info1051.en: As its name suggests, Foxhill is home to the Vulpus. Expect full-on attacks if you barge in their territory.
battle_dungeon_info1051.pt: Como o nome sugere, Foxhill é lar dos Vulpus. Espere ataques totais se invadir seu território.
battle_dungeon_info1051.ch: 此处是青丘之地，是灵狐一族的领地，擅闯它们的领地将会受到疯狂的攻击。

battle_dungeon_info106.en: Sand. Nothing but sand. Yet many unusual monsters inhabit this desert. To think any creature is able to survive in such a harsh environment... It's best to stay clear of them.
battle_dungeon_info106.pt: Areia. Nada além de areia. Ainda assim, muitos monstros incomuns habitam este deserto. Imagine que criatura pode sobreviver em um ambiente tão hostil... É melhor manter distância deles.
battle_dungeon_info106.ch: 黄沙遍地，荒芜至极，即使是如此恶劣的环境，仍然生存着各种奇特的怪物，能在这片土地生存的怪物，只有不开眼的人才会想去惹怒它们。

battle_dungeon_info1061.en: As its name suggests, Foxhill is home to the Vulpus. Expect full-on attacks if you barge in their territory.

battle_dungeon_info1084.en: Bandits set up their camp here. By robbing passersby, they've accumulated quite the wealth. Watch out for <r>Bandit Swordsmen</r> in particular!
battle_dungeon_info1084.pt: Bandidos montaram seu acampamento aqui. Ao assaltar transeuntes, acumularam uma riqueza considerável. Cuidado com os <r>Espadachins Bandidos</r> em particular!
battle_dungeon_info1084.ch: 此处有一个山贼营地，其中有不少的<r>山贼剑客</r>。山贼通过搜刮附近过路人的财物，积累了不少好东西。

battle_dungeon_info109.en: Danger lurks everywhere in these hills. Starving monsters are constantly at the ready. They can't wait to devour their prey whole.
battle_dungeon_info109.pt: Perigo espreita em toda parte nessas colinas. Monstros famintos estão sempre prontos. Mal podem esperar para devorar suas presas inteiras.
battle_dungeon_info109.ch: 在险峻的大山中，每一步都充满着危机，到处都盘踞着极度的饥饿的怪物，若是被它们发现，将会对猎物发起强烈的猛攻。

battle_dungeon_info1091.en: A wasteland occupied by monsters from the underworld.
battle_dungeon_info1091.pt: Uma terra devastada ocupada por monstros do submundo.
battle_dungeon_info1091.ch: 此处有一块弥漫着阴森之气的荒地，聚集了大量阴界魔怪。

battle_dungeon_info1092.en: A wasteland occupied by <r>Cage Zombies</r> from the underworld.
battle_dungeon_info1092.pt: Uma terra devastada ocupada por <r>Zumbis Enjaulados</r> do submundo.
battle_dungeon_info1092.ch: 此处有一块弥漫着阴森之气的荒地，聚集了大量的<r>牢笼僵尸</r>。

battle_dungeon_info1093.en: A wasteland occupied by <r>Archer Skeletons</r> from the underworld.
battle_dungeon_info1093.pt: Uma terra devastada ocupada por <r>Esqueletos Arqueiros</r> do submundo.
battle_dungeon_info1093.ch: 此处有一块弥漫着阴森之气的荒地，聚集了大量的<r>骷髅弓箭手</r>。

battle_dungeon_info1094.en: A wasteland occupied by <r>Sword Skeletons</r> from the underworld.
battle_dungeon_info1094.pt: Uma terra devastada ocupada por <r>Esqueletos Espadachins</r> do submundo.
battle_dungeon_info1094.ch: 此处有一块弥漫着阴森之气的荒地，聚集了大量的<r>骷髅剑客</r>。

battle_dungeon_info110.en: The howling wind makes it easy to ignore another strange sound. By the time you realize it's the growling sound of monsters, it's too late...
battle_dungeon_info110.pt: O vento uivante facilita ignorar outro som estranho. Quando você percebe que é o rugido dos monstros, já é tarde demais...
battle_dungeon_info110.ch: 寒风凛冽，耳边充斥着寒风呼啸的声音，但很少人能发现，伴随着风啸声还有一些奇怪的声音，当你察觉出这是魔物的低吼声时，末日也就降临在你身边了。

battle_dungeon_info1101.ch: 此处是赤幽州一处妖物兽巢，里面聚集了大量<r>赤幽州妖兽</r>。

battle_dungeon_info2101.en: Formidable Bambuki are inhabitants of this forest. They absorb Qi from nearby for their cultivation.
battle_dungeon_info2101.pt: Bambukis formidáveis são habitantes desta floresta. Eles absorvem Qi das proximidades para seu Cultivo.
battle_dungeon_info2101.ch: 此处盘踞着众多的竹木之精，它们依靠着吸取附近的灵气修炼，拥有了不可小觑的战斗力。
